plugins.name: session-buddy
plugins.description: Every conversation gets its own tidy folder: file deliverables land in buddy/<date>-<topic>/ with a README per folder and a workspace-wide buddy/INDEX.md.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 让每段对话拥有自己的文件夹：任务产物自动归档到 buddy/日期-主题/，每个文件夹一份人类可读的 README，另有 buddy/INDEX.md 总索引，根目录不再散乱。附 /tidy 命令，可一键整理已有工作区。
